name: Submission Tracker Connector
author: Submission Tracker

sections.description:
Submission Tracker Connector seamlessly integrates your existing WordPress forms with the Submission Tracker mobile app, enabling you to receive instant push notifications whenever someone submits a form on your website.

No form modifications needed! Simply install the plugin, enter your API key, and start receiving notifications.

Supported Form Plugins

  • Contact Form 7
  • Elementor Pro Forms

Key Features

  • Zero Configuration: Works with your existing forms without any changes
  • Instant Notifications: Get push notifications on your iOS/Android device immediately
  • Secure: All data transmitted via encrypted HTTPS
  • Lightweight: Minimal impact on your site performance
  • Privacy Focused: Only sends form data you choose to track

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Settings > Submission Tracker
  3. Enter your API key from submissiontracker.com.tr
  4. Done! You’ll now receive push notifications for all form submissions

Get Your API Key

To get your API key, you must first install our iOS application from the Apple App Store.

  1. Download “Submission Tracker” from the App Store.
  2. Sign up and start your 1-week free trial directly inside the app (via In-App Purchase).
  3. The app’s setup wizard will guide you to your API Key.
  4. Paste that key into the settings page below.

External Services

This plugin sends form submission data to Submission Tracker API for push notification delivery.

Service Provider: Submission Tracker (submissiontracker.com.tr)

API Endpoint: https://us-central1-message-app-a0590.cloudfunctions.net/wordpressSubmission

What data is sent:
* Form field names and values submitted by users
* Form name/title
* No other WordPress data, user information, or site data is transmitted

When data is sent: Every time a Contact Form 7 or Elementor Pro form is submitted on your website.

Why: To deliver instant push notifications to the website owner’s mobile device.

Service Terms & Privacy:
* Terms of Service: https://submissiontracker.com.tr/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://submissiontracker.com.tr/privacy

Privacy Policy

This plugin sends form submission data to Submission Tracker’s API (submissiontracker.com.tr) when forms are submitted. The data transmitted includes:

  • Form field names and values
  • Form name/title
  • Submission timestamp (added by API)

No other WordPress data, user information, or site data is transmitted. For more information, visit our privacy policy at submissiontracker.com.tr/privacy

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit:
* Website: https://submissiontracker.com.tr
* Email: support@submissiontracker.com.tr
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Submission Tracker Connector”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

After Installation

  1. Go to Settings > Submission Tracker
  2. Enter your API key (get one at submissiontracker.com.tr)
  3. Click “Save Changes”

Note: You must have Contact Form 7 or Elementor Pro installed and activated for this plugin to work.
sections.faq:
Do I need Contact Form 7 or Elementor Pro?

Yes, you need at least one of these form plugins installed and activated. The connector works with both.

Where do I get an API key?

Visit submissiontracker.com.tr and sign up for a free 7-day trial. Your API key will be provided after registration.

Will this work with other form plugins?

Currently, only Contact Form 7 and Elementor Pro Forms are supported. More integrations coming soon!

Does this slow down my website?

No. The plugin sends data asynchronously after form submission, so it doesn’t affect your site’s performance or user experience.

Is my data secure?

Yes. All data is transmitted via encrypted HTTPS connections. We follow WordPress security best practices.

What data is sent to Submission Tracker?

Only the form field names and values submitted by users. No other WordPress data is transmitted.

Can I use this on multiple websites?

Yes, but each website requires its own API key from your Submission Tracker account.
